{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Wood Snake''' (乙巳, ''kinoto mi''; onyomi ''otsushi'') is the 42nd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 42nd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Wood Dragon|ja|甲辰}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Fire Horse|ja|丙午}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''乙'' is Yin Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Wood Snake (乙巳)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): yǐsì
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jyut3 si6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoto-mi
*** On'yomi: otsushi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): eulsa (을사)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Ất Tỵ

=== Events ===
* The downfall of the Soga clan by {{ill|Emperor Tenji|ja|中大兄皇子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Naka no Ōe|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天智天皇|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q314802}} and [[:en:Nakatomi no Kamatari|Nakatomi no Kamatari]] in {{ill|645|en|645|qid=Q31040|lt=645}} is known as the {{ill|Isshi incident|en|Isshi incident|qid=Q1062771|lt=Isshi Incident}}.
* The {{ill|Japan–Korea Treaty of 1905|en|Japan–Korea Treaty of 1905|qid=Q233254|lt=Eulsa Treaty}}, signed in {{ill|1905|en|1905|qid=Q2047|lt=1905}}, is referred to as the '''Eulsa''' Protection Treaty in Korea.

==Months of Yin Wood Snake==
April of years ending in 2 or 7 (where the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ding}}) corresponds to the Yin Wood Snake {{ill|Moon|en|Moon|qid=Q405|lt=Month}}. However, in the case of traditional calendars, the Yin Wood Snake month may be applied based on the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}} or {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}} to the day before {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong}}).

==Days of Yin Wood Snake==

=== Special Calendar Notations ===
* Yin Wood Snake day is the 13th day of the {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tianyi Tian Shang|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}} cycle.
